description.raw: '''Active:''' '''Shen''' recalls his Spirit Blade to him. Enemy champions hit by the Spirit Blade along its path are [[File:Slow icon.png|20px|link=Slow|An icon representing the keyword Slow]] [[:Slow|slowed]] for the next 2 seconds while moving away from '''Shen'''.
description.text: Active: Shen recalls his Spirit Blade to him. Enemy champions hit by the Spirit Blade along its path are slowed for the next 2 seconds while moving away from Shen.

description2.raw: Once it arrives, '''Shen''' empowers his next 3 [[File:Basic attack cursor icon.png|20px|link=Basic attack|An icon representing the keyword Basic attack]] [[:Basic attack|basic attacks]] within 8 seconds to gain [[File:Range icon.png|15px|link=Range]] 75 '''bonus''' range and deal '''bonus''' magic damage [[File:On-hit icon.png|20px|link=Attack_effects#On_Hitting|An icon representing the keyword On-hit]] [[:Attack_effects#On_Hitting|on-hit]]. Against [[File:Structure icon.png|20px|link=Category:Structure|An icon representing the keyword Structure]] [[:Category:Structure|structures]], only the flat damage portion is applied.
description2.text: Once it arrives, Shen empowers his next 3 basic attacks within 8 seconds to gain  75 bonus range and deal bonus magic damage on-hit. Against structures, only the flat damage portion is applied.

description3.raw: If the Spirit Blade hits at least one enemy [[File:Champion icon.png|20px|link=Champion|An icon representing the keyword Champion]] [[:Champion|champion]] during the travel, the attacks are further enhanced to deal [[File:Successfully enhanced damage magic icon.png|20px|link=Damage#Successful_ability_casts]] '''increased bonus''' magic damage and additionally grant '''Shen''' [[File:Attack speed icon.png|15px|link=Attack speed]] 50% '''bonus''' attack speed.
description3.text: If the Spirit Blade hits at least one enemy champion during the travel, the attacks are further enhanced to deal increased bonus magic damage and additionally grant Shen  50% bonus attack speed.

description4.raw: Empowered attacks against [[File:Monster icon.png|20px|link=Monster|An icon representing the keyword Monster]] [[:Monster|monsters]] deal 100% '''bonus''' damage, but their '''total''' damage is capped.
description4.text: Empowered attacks against monsters deal 100% bonus damage, but their total damage is capped.

leveling2.raw:
'''Bonus Magic Damage:'''
10 – 40 (based on level) (+ 2 / 2.5 / 3 / 3.5 / 4% (+ 1.5% per 100 AP) of target's '''maximum''' health)
'''Total Magic Damage:'''
30 – 120 (based on level) (+ 6 / 7.5 / 9 / 10.5 / 12% (+ 4.5% per 100 AP) of target's '''maximum''' health)
leveling2.text: Bonus Magic Damage:10 – 40 (based on level) (+ 2 / 2.5 / 3 / 3.5 / 4% (+ 1.5% per 100 AP) of target's maximum health)Total Magic Damage:30 – 120 (based on level) (+ 6 / 7.5 / 9 / 10.5 / 12% (+ 4.5% per 100 AP) of target's maximum health)

leveling3.raw:
'''Increased Bonus Damage:'''
10 – 40 (based on level) (+ 5 / 5.5 / 6 / 6.5 / 7% (+ 2% per 100 AP) of target's '''maximum''' health)
'''Total Increased Damage:'''
30 – 120 (based on level) (+ 15 / 16.5 / 18 / 19.5 / 21% (+ 6% per 100 AP) of target's '''maximum''' health)
leveling3.text: Increased Bonus Damage:10 – 40 (based on level) (+ 5 / 5.5 / 6 / 6.5 / 7% (+ 2% per 100 AP) of target's maximum health)Total Increased Damage:30 – 120 (based on level) (+ 15 / 16.5 / 18 / 19.5 / 21% (+ 6% per 100 AP) of target's maximum health)

notes.raw: * The Spirit Blade will track '''Shen''' as it is traveling to him, following his movements if he changes locations while the blade is in-flight. * The Spirit Blade will stop in place upon colliding with [[File:Projectile.png|20px|link=Projectile|An icon representing the keyword Projectile]] [[:Projectile|projectile-intercepting]] effects. If this occurs, '''Shen''' will not gain the empowered attacks as the Spirit Blade failed to complete its travel to him. * When it is recalled, the Spirit Blade also checks for units whose [[File:Gameplay radius.png|20px|link=Unit size|An icon representing the keyword Gameplay radius]] [[:Unit size|gameplay radius]] it overlaps with (equal to a [[File:Range model.png|20px|link=Range|An icon representing the keyword Edge range]] 0 radius check) before flying off, allowing it to hit enemies whose center is behind the missile origin. * The empowered attack will not trigger against [[File:Ward_icon.png|20px|link=Ward|An icon representing the keyword Ward]] [[:Ward|wards]].
notes.text:
The Spirit Blade will track Shen as it is traveling to him, following his movements if he changes locations while the blade is in-flight.
The Spirit Blade will stop in place upon colliding with projectile-intercepting effects. If this occurs, Shen will not gain the empowered attacks as the Spirit Blade failed to complete its travel to him.
When it is recalled, the Spirit Blade also checks for units whose gameplay radius it overlaps with (equal to a 0 radius check) before flying off, allowing it to hit enemies whose center is behind the missile origin.
The empowered attack will not trigger against wards.
